title: ResourceValue
description: A session-scoped, versioned private resource. Rust: crates/agentscope-durable/src/types/resource.rs::ResourceValue. Java: DurableTypes.ResourceValue. A mutation advances the thread's resourcePosition, so a checkpoint and the resources it depends on stay paired.

namespace.description: Namespace path; ResourceValue::validate rejects more than 32 parts.

value.description: Resource payload. Both ResourceValue::validate and ResourceRequest::validate require an object, not an arbitrary JSON value.

version.description: Monotonic version, starting at 1. CAS requests carry expectedVersion; 0 means 'create only'.

ResourceOperation.description: Operations a ResourceRequest may name; GET/SEARCH are reads and never write.
